1. (Currently Amended) A process for obtaining a valued material from an aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution containing the valued material comprising adding to the aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution a Maillard reaction product, the Maillard reaction product comprising an adduct of (1) an amine reactant and (2) a reducing sugar, a reducing sugar equivalent, or a mixture thereof, __wherein the Maillard reaction product is formed by heating the amine reactant and the reducing sugar, reducing sugar equivalent, or mixture thereof to a temperature sufficient to produce browning and the characteristic odor and flavor of Maillard reaction products__.

2. (Currently Amended) A process for emulsifying a material comprising agitating the material in a suitable liquid in the presence of a Maillard reaction product, the Maillard reaction product comprising an adduct of (1) an amine reactant and (2) a reducing sugar, a reducing sugar equivalent, or a mixture thereof.

3. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the amine reactant contains at least one amine functional group, and wherein a molar ratio of the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof to the amine functional group is about 1:1 to about 3:1, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product exhibits a color change indicative of Maillard reaction progression__.

4. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof is selected from the group consisting of: dextrose, fructose, high fructose corn syrup, erythrulose, ribulose, xylulose, psicose, sorbose, tagatose, glyceraldehyde, erythrose, threose, ribose, arabinose, xylose, allose, altrose, mannose, gulose, galactose, talose, maltose, lactose, furfural, pyruvaldehyde, acetaldehyde, crotonaldehyde, 2-furaldehyde, glycolaldehyde, glycolaldehyde dimer, trans-3-(2-furyl)acrolein, acrolein, 5-hydroxymethylfurfural, 5-methylfurfural, 4-hydroxycrotonaldehyde, and cinnamaldehyde, and wherein the amine reactant is selected from the group consisting of: ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product is formed by heating the amine reactant and the reducing sugar or equivalent__.

5. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product has a cationic functionality, a sulfur functionality, a phosphorus functionality, a sulfate functionality, a sulfonate functionality, a hydroxamic acid functionality, a silane functionality, a phenolic functionality, or an aza crown chelating functionality, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product is formed by heating the amine reactant and the reducing sugar or equivalent to produce the desired functionality__.

6. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by heating the amine reactant and the reducing sugar to a temperature and for a time sufficient to produce a brown-colored adduct.

7. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by reacting the amine reactant, the reducing sugar, and a non-carbohydrate polyhydroxy reactant __under heating conditions__.

8. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by reacting the amine reactant, the reducing sugar, and a polycarboxylic acid __under heating conditions__.

9. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the valued material is obtained by sedimentation, filtration, or flotation, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product alters the surface properties of the valued material or impurities to facilitate separation__.

10. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, further comprising recovering the valued material from the aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution after adding the Maillard reaction product thereto to produce a purified product, wherein the purified product contains a reduced concentration of at least one impurity relative to the aqueous suspension, dispersion, or solution, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product modifies the hydrophobicity or charge of the valued material or impurities__.

11. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product depresses the valued material or an impurity in the aqueous suspension, dispersion, or solution __by modifying surface properties thereof__.

12. (Original) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product promotes flotation of the value material or an impurity in the aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution.

13. (Currently Amended) A process for separating a valued material from a suspension, dispersion, or solution, comprising: treating the liquid suspension, dispersion, or solution with a Maillard reaction product of (1) an amine and (2) a reducing sugar, a reducing sugar equivalent, or a mixture thereof, __wherein the Maillard reaction product is formed by heating the amine and the reducing sugar, reducing sugar equivalent, or mixture thereof__, to provide a treated mixture; and removing a purified valued material from the treated mixture.

14. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the Maillard reaction product further comprises a non-carboxylic polyhydroxy compound or a polycarboxylic acid, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product is formed by heating the amine, the reducing sugar, and the non-carbohydrate polyhydroxy compound or polycarboxylic acid__.

15. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by heating the amine and the reducing sugar to a temperature and for a time sufficient to produce a brown-colored adduct.

16. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the amine contains at least one amine functional group, and wherein a molar ratio of the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof to the amine functional group is about 1:1 to about 3:1, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product exhibits a color change indicative of Maillard reaction progression__.

17. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof contains an aldehyde moiety reactive with Cu+2 to produce a carboxylic acid moiety, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product is formed by heating the amine and the reducing sugar or equivalent__.

18. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof is selected from the group consisting of: dextrose, fructose, high fructose corn syrup, erythrulose, ribulose, xylulose, psicose, sorbose, tagatose, glyceraldehyde, erythrose, threose, ribose, arabinose, xylose, allose, altrose, mannose, gulose, galactose, talose, maltose, lactose, furfural, pyruvaldehyde, acetaldehyde, crotonaldehyde, 2-furaldehyde, glycolaldehyde, glycolaldehyde dimer, trans-3-(2-furyl)acrolein, acrolein, 5-hydroxymethylfurfural, 5-methylfurfural, 4-hydroxycrotonaldehyde, and cinnamaldehyde, and wherein the amine is selected from the group consisting of: ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product is formed by heating the amine and the reducing sugar or equivalent__.

19. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the Maillard reaction product depresses the valued material or an impurity present in the treated mixture __by modifying surface properties thereof__, or wherein the Maillard reaction product promotes flotation of the valued material or the impurity in the treated mixture __by modifying surface properties thereof__.

20. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the purified valued material is removed from the treated mixture by sedimentation, filtration, or flotation, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product alters the surface properties of the valued material or impurities to facilitate separation__.
